\caption{
\textbf{Smoothness comparison (lower is better).}
The smoothness metric quantifies the average gradient magnitude of class probability maps, where smaller values indicate more stable decision regions.
\textbf{Graph Memory (GM)} consistently achieves smoother boundaries, reducing the smoothness score by \textbf{30-40\%} compared to $k$NN and by over \textbf{94\%} relative to LabelSpreading.
This confirms that GM produces significantly flatter and more regular decision surfaces while retaining high accuracy and calibration.
}
\label{tab:smooth}
\end{table*}
